cardName: Deck title: FrizzleBob's Kafab-Alice in Blödsinn-Land
songLine: This is Blödsinn-Land. / Nonsense-Land, for the tourists.
reason: Unchanged from wr1: 'Blödsinn' kept as brand word and hook shout, glossed once. Phonetic fallback if Suno mangles the umlaut: 'Blerd-zin' (dossier only, text keeps 'Blödsinn').

songLine: the second anything makes sense, the whole room yells / Blödsinn! / And we fall all over again.
reason: Review: 'Laugh. Rewind. Keep falling.' read as an instruction; now a consequence, not an order.

songLine: The White Rabbit: oh my ears and whiskers, how late it's getting! Possibly I'm a hallucination.
reason: Review: 'late for a very important date' is the Disney lyric; replaced with Carroll's own words (1865, public domain). Printed lore keeps the canonical wording.

songLine: The Caterpillar: who are you? / Wrong answer.
reason: Review: pause risk; question and verdict on separate lines. 'Rejects your answer' performed before you can even answer.

songLine: Smile. The Cheshire Cat: we're all mad here, I'm just honest about it. And I was never here.
reason: Review: 'that last card was never there' recited a game effect; GASLIGHT now performed in-world.

songLine: The Mad Hatter: I murdered Time. Now it's always six. Always tea.
reason: 'eternal 6:00 PM' as 'always six'; art description (hat label) and filibuster dropped for groove.

songLine: The March Hare: have some tea. Have some more. It was the best butter!
reason: Short claim format; FORCED TEA performed as pushy hosting.

songLine: Shh. The Dormouse: breathing while I sleep is sleeping while I breathe. Twinkle, twinkle, little bat… zzz.
reason: First-person lore; margin text 'Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Bat!' planted for Give Evidence; NARCOLEPSY as 'zzz'.

songLine: The King of Hearts: pardoned! Pardoned! All of you! Is she looking?
reason: Lore 'Pardons everyone when the Queen isn't looking' performed as action instead of described.

songLine: The Duchess: everything has a moral, if you can find it. And tonight's moral is nobody mentions the pig.
reason: MORALIZING power as punchline (invented rule); pig from the card image.

songLine: Eyes down. The Visitor: the girl who fell in. I change size. Don't look directly at me.
reason: Review: the hinge card was unclear; 'the girl who fell in' tells the listener who it is without naming the banned Alice. 'Do not look directly at her' from the rules page.

songLine: Down we go! The Rabbit Hole: gravity optional. Hey, isn't that the marmalade you threw away?
reason: Review: 'every card you threw away falls right back' recited the retrieve-discards effect; now performed with the marmalade jar from the image.

songLine: The Pool of Tears: I'm salty. Somebody cried an ocean.
reason: SALTY as pun; nose-holding instruction dropped.

songLine: The Hall of Doors: a hundred doors, one tiny key, and every lock whispers, riddle first.
reason: Review: 'nothing opens until you solve a riddle' recited LOCKED OUT; the locks now speak. Sets up the Riddle callback.

songLine: The Duchess's Kitchen: pepper everywhere. Ah-choo! That's etiquette.
reason: Spelled 'Duchess's' so the possessive is sung; PEPPER SNEEZE performed.

songLine: Still six o'clock. The Mad Tea Party: no room! No room! Move one down. Move one down.
reason: TIME LOOP performed as repetition; opener calls back to the Hatter.

songLine: The Rose Garden: I was planted white. I'm wearing red now. Don't touch, still wet.
reason: COVER UP as image; owns the paint motif so Paint the Roses can tell a different beat.

songLine: Hear ye! The High Tribunal: logic is forbidden in this court. One guinea pig cheered. Suppressed. And if your story makes sense— / Blödsinn!
reason: Printed 'call "Blödsinn!"' kept as gang shout; 'suppressed' guinea pig from the page margin.

songLine: The Mock Turtle's Rock: sigh. Once I was a real turtle. Now every story ends in soup. Beautiful soup.
reason: Review: double sigh; one sigh only, then Carroll's 'Beautiful Soup' (mock turtle soup) as punchline.

songLine: Eat me. Suspicious Cake: one bite and you're a giant. Hello up there, King.
reason: GROW ('intimidate the King') performed as a greeting from above.

songLine: Drink me. Unknown Bottle: one sip and you're tiny. Small enough to hide in a teacup.
reason: Review: 'hide inside somebody else's card' recited SHRINK; now an in-world image (teacup).

songLine: The Mushroom: one side grows you, one side shrinks you. Land on the edge, and your neck goes up like a serpent.
reason: Printed typo 'like like a serpent' fixed; coin flip compressed.

songLine: Change of subject. The Vorpal Flamingo: snicker-snack! I swing at conversations. Lovely weather, isn't it?
reason: BLUNT FORCE performed: the line changes topic itself.

songLine: The Squeaky Slate-Pencil: don't say it. Write it. Screeeech.
reason: 'SCREECH' stretched so Suno performs it.

songLine: The Treacle Well: sticky, sweet and bottomless. You're staying. Humbug!
reason: STICKY TRAP performed as 'You're staying'; 'Humbug!' from the page.

songLine: Quick, the brushes! Paint the Roses Red: three gardeners, one bucket. She's coming round the corner. Faster, faster!
reason: Review: repeated the Rose Garden beat; now the panic of the Goal ('before the Queen arrives'). 'Quest:' label dropped.

songLine: Late again. Find the Gloves: Mary Ann! Fetch my gloves! I'm not Mary Ann. Fetch them anyway.
reason: 'Quest:' label dropped; Risk (mistaken for Mary Ann) acted out.

songLine: Solve the Riddle: why is a raven like a writing desk? / No answer. / So: why is a raven like a writing desk?
reason: 'Quest:' label dropped; question and answer separated; infinite loop performed.

songLine: Order, order! Who Stole the Tarts? The Knave did. We all watched him run. Exhibit A: a poem that makes no sense.
reason: 'Quest:' label and Goal/Risk telegram dropped.

songLine: Take the stand. Give Evidence: I swear I'll get it right. Twinkle, twinkle, little bat, how I wonder what you're at—
reason: 'Quest:' label dropped; wrong poem recited (Dormouse callback).

songLine: A tip from Uncle FrizzleBob: when the Queen gets angry, remember she's made of cardboard.
reason: 'Pro tip' reworded (used as opener in the 9/11 song); FrizzleBob's only appearance.

songLine: Wake up. / Did we win? / Who cares. / You're holding the cards. / Blödsinn!
reason: Review: dropped 'The End? / No.' (used in three songs) and the 'Cut them out' instruction; ends on the shout.

cardName: Deck title: FrizzleBob's Kafab-Alice in Blödsinn-Land
songLine: This is Blödsinn-Land. / Nonsense-Land, for the tourists.
reason: 'Blödsinn' kept as brand word: two hard syllables, works as a gang shout and is the deck's own interrupt call. Glossed once as 'Nonsense-Land' so English listeners get it; the gloss is the joke. 'Kafab-Alice' (printed title) is not sung: it breaks spoken and the deck bans Alice anyway.

cardName: Rules page: NEW RULE: BLÖDSINN! (Nonsense Check)
songLine: the second anything makes sense, the whole room yells / Blödsinn! / Laugh. Rewind. Keep falling.
reason: Printed 'If the story gets too logical ... yell BLÖDSINN! ... Laugh. Rewind. Continue.' compressed into the intro hook; 'Continue' changed to 'Keep falling' to set up the rabbit-hole rewind.

songLine: Smile: The Cheshire Cat, we're all mad here, I'm just honest about it; the grin stays, the cat goes, and that last card was never there.
reason: POWER 'GASLIGHT: remove a card, claim it was never there' used only as punchline, not as a rule.

songLine: Six o'clock sharp: The Mad Hatter, I murdered Time, now it's always tea; ten-and-six in the hatband, and I talk and I talk and I never stop to breathe.
reason: Printed 'eternal 6:00 PM' (digits read badly) becomes 'six o'clock' in the opener plus 'always tea'; hat label '10/6' spoken as 'ten-and-six'; FILIBUSTER power performed as breathless talk instead of a rule.

songLine: Shh: The Dormouse, breathing while I sleep is sleeping while I breathe; curled up in the teapot, humming twinkle, twinkle, little bat… scene over.
reason: Lore turned first person and shortened for rhythm ('Breathing while sleeping is the same as sleeping while breathing'); 'Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Bat!' from the page margin planted as a callback for Give Evidence; NARCOLEPSY as 'scene over'.

songLine: Eyes down: The Visitor, the Anomaly, a cryptid ape, I change size, don't look directly at me; no fur, static for a face, a whole galaxy in my dress.
reason: Parentheses in the card name dropped for speech; 'Do not look directly at her' moved in from the rules page; 'Ask the Dodo for classification' becomes the Dodo stanza beat that triggers the mid-song Blödsinn reset.

songLine: The Pool of Tears, I'm salty, somebody cried an ocean; the Dodo swims laps, the mouse panics, and everybody talks through a pinched nose.
reason: Telegram-style 'SALTY: All communication must be done while holding your nose' turned into a pun ('I'm salty') plus an image instead of an instruction.

songLine: Bless you: The Duchess's Kitchen, ...
reason: Spelled 'Duchess's' so the possessive is sung ('Duchess-iz'); printed 'Duchess'' tends to be swallowed.

songLine: Hear ye: The High Tribunal, logic is forbidden in this court; twelve jurors with slates, one guinea pig cheered, into the sack, and if your story makes sense— / Blödsinn!
reason: Printed 'call "Blödsinn!"' kept verbatim as gang shout (brand word, see title entry); 'suppressed' guinea pig from the page margin rendered as 'into the sack'.

songLine: Pick a side: The Mushroom, one side grows you, one side shrinks you; flip a coin, and if it lands on the edge, your neck goes up like a serpent.
reason: Printed typo 'Neck grows like like a serpent' fixed; Heads/Tails shorthand opened up for speech.

songLine: The Squeaky Slate-Pencil, you're talking? Write it down instead; every word you say comes out screeeech.
reason: Image caption 'SCREECH' stretched to 'screeeech' so Suno performs the sound.

songLine: Quick, the brushes: Paint the Roses Red, somebody planted white by mistake; slap it red before the Queen arrives, or lose your head.
reason: 'QUEST:' label dropped (would stack two colons with the opener); 'Risk: Decapitation' spoken as 'or lose your head'.

songLine: Late again: Find the Gloves, the Rabbit needs his gloves and his fan; fetch them, Mary Ann! I'm not Mary Ann. Fetch them anyway.
reason: 'QUEST:' label dropped; 'Risk: Being mistaken for the housemaid Mary Ann' acted out as dialogue.

songLine: Solve the Riddle: why is a raven like a writing desk? / There is no answer. / So: why is a raven like a writing desk?
reason: 'QUEST:' label dropped; question and answer on separate lines; 'Infinite loop' performed by repeating the question instead of naming it.

songLine: Order, order: Who Stole the Tarts? The Knave did, we all watched him run; open and shut, except the evidence is a poem, and the poem makes no sense.
reason: 'Quest:' label and 'Goal/Risk' telegram dropped; the Knave running with tarts comes from the card image.

songLine: Take the stand: Give Evidence, I swear I'll recite it correctly; twinkle, twinkle, little bat, how I wonder what you're at—
reason: 'Quest:' label dropped; 'Risk: the words come out wrong' performed by reciting the wrong poem (callback to the Dormouse).

songLine: A tip from Uncle FrizzleBob: when the Queen gets angry, remember she's made of cardboard.
reason: Printed 'Pro Tip: If the Queen gets angry, just remember she's made of cardboard.' 'Pro tip' is already used as an opener in the 9/11 song, so it's reworded; this is FrizzleBob's only appearance.
